newsitem.title: UK: RSA shares lead insurers up, Salomon bullish.
newsitem.headline: RSA shares lead insurers up, Salomon bullish.

text.p: Shares in Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc led UK composite insurers higher on Thursday on the back of persistent bid rumours and a bullish report on the sector by analysts at Salomon Brothers, dealers said.
By 1127 GMT, Royal Sun Alliance was 13p higher at 465-1/2. Guardian Royal Exchange firmed five pence higher to 284-1/2 and General Accident climbed 20p to 813-1/2.
Salomon analyst Andrew Pitt said his strongest buy recommendation was Royal Sun Alliance. Salomon were also buyers of Guardian Royal Exchange and General Accident.

"It's a very cheap sector," Pitt said. "People need to focus on the big picture for the UK insurance sector. A lot of the noise about overcapitalisation, premium rates weakness and so on is really missing the big picture."

He said Salomon had looked at how much value added insurance companies were creating relative to investment trusts. "It's crazy -- you've got stocks trading on just slight premiums to investment trust multiples," he said.
Pitt said he expected 1997 to be the bottom of the earnings cycle for the sector.
Insurance stocks have been strong this week on market talk that a bid could emerge in the sector.
"They've been strong all week and bid talk is still bringing in speculative buyers," one marketmaker said.
